title: FinOps/GreenIT — 3. Green IT
description: Energy and CO₂ with their provenance (measured vs estimated).

list.name: cluster
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT cluster FROM metric_snapshots ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT cluster FROM metric_snapshots ORDER BY 1

list.name: namespace
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM metric_snapshots WHERE cluster IN ($cluster) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM metric_snapshots WHERE cluster IN ($cluster) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(energy_kwh) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cluster, namespace) * FROM metric_snapshots
   WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) ORDER BY cluster, namespace, time DESC) l

panels.title: CO₂, last 24 h (kg)
panels.description: kWh × PUE × grid intensity / 1000 (constants in config).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(co2e_kg) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cluster, namespace) * FROM metric_snapshots
   WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) ORDER BY cluster, namespace, time DESC) l

panels.title: Namespaces with ESTIMATED energy
panels.description: Estimated = Kepler power MODEL (no hardware counters) or node-level share. Measured = RAPL package+dram attributed per container.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cluster, namespace) * FROM metric_snapshots
   WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) ORDER BY cluster, namespace, time DESC) l
WHERE energy_attribution = 'node_cpu_share' OR energy_power_source = 'model'

SELECT bucket AS time, cluster || '/' || namespace AS metric, SUM(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('$__interval'::interval, time) AS bucket, cluster, namespace, AVG(energy_kwh) AS v
  FROM metric_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) s
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, cluster || '/' || namespace AS metric, SUM(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('$__interval'::interval, time) AS bucket, cluster, namespace, AVG(co2e_kg) AS v
  FROM metric_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) AND co2e_kg IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) s
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy provenance (latest)
panels.description: Wh and g (small local clusters). idle empty = not measurable with this Kepler exposure; no ENERGY_WASTE advice is emitted then.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cluster, namespace,
  CASE WHEN energy_kwh IS NULL THEN 'unavailable'
       WHEN energy_power_source = 'hardware' AND energy_attribution IN ('container','pod') THEN 'measured'
       ELSE 'estimated' END AS precision,
  energy_power_source AS power_source, energy_scope AS scope, energy_attribution AS attribution,
  ROUND((energy_kwh * 1000)::numeric, 3) AS energy_wh, ROUND((idle_energy_kwh * 1000)::numeric, 3) AS idle_wh,
  ROUND((co2e_kg * 1000)::numeric, 3) AS co2_g FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cluster, namespace) * FROM metric_snapshots
   WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace) ORDER BY cluster, namespace, time DESC) l ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: CO₂ per workload (per cycle, g)
panels.description: Kepler per container, joined to the pod's app label. Sum of per-cycle amounts (exact).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval'::interval, time) AS time,
  cluster || '/' || namespace || '/' || workload AS metric, sum(co2_interval_kg) * 1000 AS value
FROM workload_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace)
  AND co2_interval_kg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy & CO₂ per workload — period total

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cluster, namespace, workload,
  max(energy_precision) AS precision, max(energy_power_source) AS power_source,
  ROUND((sum(energy_interval_kwh) * 1000)::numeric, 3) AS energy_wh, ROUND((sum(co2_interval_kg) * 1000)::numeric, 3) AS co2_g
FROM workload_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cluster IN ($cluster) AND namespace IN ($namespace)
  AND energy_interval_kwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY co2_g DESC
